categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Electric Power Engineering Technology Services, including power consulting and design, power engineering construction, power equipment sales, and power operation and maintenance services; and (2) Geographic Information Technology Services, including geographic information data services and digital twin management platforms based on proprietary 3DGIS and cloud rendering engine technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses over 20 years of digital technology accumulation with core proprietary technologies including 3DGIS engine, cloud rendering engine, and digital twin platforms. For power services, the company utilizes comprehensive engineering design methodologies covering feasibility studies, detailed design, and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) total contracting. For geographic information services, the company employs multi-source data fusion, 3D visualization, and real-time interactive technologies to create digital twin applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are electric power enterprises, including State Grid Corporation of China and its subsidiaries, as well as industrial and commercial enterprises seeking comprehensive energy services. Key end markets include power grid construction and operation, new energy development, energy efficiency management, and smart city/park applications. The company serves customers across power generation, transmission, distribution, and end-user energy management sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. While the company has historically concentrated operations in Zhejiang Province (72.17% of 2023 revenue), it has expanded to multiple provinces including Inner Mongolia, Shanghai, and other regions. The company is actively expanding its geographic footprint beyond Zhejiang to reduce regional concentration risk.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the energy supply chain: upstream (planning and consulting), midstream (design and engineering), and downstream (construction, equipment supply, operation and maintenance). The company positions itself as a comprehensive energy service provider offering full lifecycle services from project conception through operation and maintenance, functioning as both a service provider and system integrator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is to become a leading comprehensive energy service operator in China. R&D priorities include: (1) new energy technologies and applications; (2) digital twin and smart energy management platforms; (3) energy efficiency and carbon management solutions; (4) grid modernization and smart grid technologies; and (5) integrated energy service platforms. The company invested 27.56 million yuan in R&D in 2023, representing 5.36% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through multiple streams: (1) consulting and design services (36.06% of 2023 revenue) charged on project basis; (2) engineering construction and EPC contracts (36.99% of revenue) with fixed or cost-plus pricing; (3) equipment and material sales (18.06% of revenue); (4) geographic information technology services (7.16% of revenue) including platform development and data services; and (5) operation and maintenance services. Revenue is recognized upon project completion, customer acceptance, or service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other power engineering design and consulting firms, construction companies, and emerging digital energy service providers. The company positions itself as a differentiated player combining comprehensive power engineering capabilities with advanced digital twin and energy management technologies. Key competitive advantages include integrated full-lifecycle service capabilities, proprietary digital technologies, and strong relationships with major power utilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized energy services provider with 2023 revenue of 514.5 million yuan, representing 18.75% growth from 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 56.2 million yuan in 2023 (down 24.83% from 2022 due to lower consulting design margins). Total assets reached 1.199 billion yuan at year-end 2023 (up 92.28% from 2022), reflecting the impact of IPO fundraising. The company went public on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in May 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core value proposition centers on providing integrated, full-lifecycle comprehensive energy services combining traditional power engineering expertise with advanced digital technologies. Key differentiators include: (1) complete service chain from consulting through operation; (2) proprietary digital twin and energy management platforms with 20+ years of technology development; (3) comprehensive resource qualifications including Grade A surveying and mapping, Grade A power design, and Grade B new energy design credentials; (4) ability to serve customers across generation, transmission, distribution, and end-user segments; and (5) focus on energy efficiency, carbon management, and smart energy solutions aligned with China's dual-carbon objectives.
